newsitem.title: GERMANY: ProSieben to buy Nickelodeon stake - report.
newsitem.headline: ProSieben to buy Nickelodeon stake - report.

text.p: German television network ProSieben AG is interested in taking a majority stake in the German version of children's network Nickelodeon from Viacom Inc, a German newspaper reported on Sunday.
The Welt am Sonntag newspaper said ProSieben, which recently issued shares in an initial public offering, would sign a deal with Viacom in the coming days.
ProSieben and officials at the German unit of Nickelodeon declined to comment on the report.
The German version of Nickelodeon was started in July 1995, with Viacom holding a 90 percent stake and the rest held by Ravensburger Film+TV GmbH.
The report said Ravensburger wants to sell its entire stake in Nickelodeon.
